title: The Critical Technology in Finding Critical Materials

reader_summary.headline: There is a phrase that's common in the mining world which goes something like if you can't grow it you must mine it..
reader_summary.overview: There is a phrase that's common in the mining world which goes something like if you can't grow it you must mine it. That's so central to understand that so much of our physical world around us, our homes, our cars, everything on our table tops. These things require materials that must be mined from the earth's surface and below.

thesis: The podcast argues that the global energy transition requires the discovery of approximately one thousand new mines to supply the critical metals needed for two billion electric vehicles, as recycling cannot replace the initial materials required to build those vehicles. It further explains that while these metals are not rare in the Earth's crust, finding economically viable deposits is difficult because specific geological conditions are required to concentrate them, and the industry faces a significant time lag between identifying a deposit and actually extracting the metal.
